# requires

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:requires`](gmeow-requires.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/requires>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

    gmeow:requiresHost   false ;

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when one creative work depends on another to function, be delivered, or remain coherent (the [dcterms:requires](http://purl.org/dc/terms/requires) bridge — a manual that needs its runtime, a score that needs its parts).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for derivation lineage (use [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) subproperties), for standards conformance (use [`gmeow:conformsTo`](gmeow-conformsTo.md)), and for versions (use [`gmeow:hasVersion`](gmeow-hasVersion.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the dependent work to the required one; read the inverse [`gmeow:isRequiredBy`](gmeow-isRequiredBy.md) for the reverse direction.
